thread:
Eli: kicking off a new micro-pilot for SI cohort onboarding focused on hw-vouchers + marketplace quick-list. aiming 3-week turnaround.
Nina: sounds good. goal = time-to-demo <= 14 days. can we define a tiny intake form?
Harper: suggested intake fields:
```
- si_name
- primary_contact
- target_solution
- vendor_hw (yes/no)
- desired_badges
- preferred_region
```
Eli: add procurement_ok (yes/no) — some vendors require PO before voucher release.
Nina: for badges, prefer capability tags (deploy, infra, monitoring). issue badge when evidence uploaded to partner repo.
Harper: evidence flow idea: partner pushes /evidence/manifest.json + screenshot/logs, we run a CI job to validate and then call LMS webhook.
tech-ops-bot: creating ticket INF-3012 to add repo template + CI check (JSON schema). ETA 3 days.
biz-dev: could we offer a "voucher escrow" for vendors that need extra approvals? sales can pre-fund small vouchers to speed onboarding.
Eli: good option. add a procurement gate in intake: if procurement_ok=no then escalate to biz-dev.
Nina: pilot acceptance criteria: two SIs complete deploy badge + marketplace quick-list in 3w, no blocker older than 72h.
Harper: I'll draft the quick-list template (short blurb, assets, supported modes) and post it here.
Eli: ok team. action items:
- Harper: quick-list template (2d)
- Nina: intake form + proc gate (1d)
- tech-ops-bot: INF-3012 repo + CI (3d)
- biz-dev: voucher escrow feasibility (4d)
Eli: planning a 15m check-in next Tue. ping if anything blocks. :rocket:
